name: Starswirl Academy
source:
Welcome to Starswirl Academy: one of the most prestigious high schools in the country. Classes and extracurricular activities cater to the needs of each individual student. At Starswirl, we feel that an emphasis on a person's special talent is what sets us apart from the rest. While enrolled, the use of the campus' facilities is not only allowed, but encouraged to aid in the pursuit of honing your own skills.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120924234416/http://www.zap-apple.com/p/about.html]Zap-Apple[/url]]

Cancelled. Assets released on [url=https://rosin.itch.io/starswirl]itch.io[/url] under Creative Commons CC BY-NC-SA.
